article.title: Shopping at a Japanese Drugstore: Location, Price, and Tax-Free Questions

paragraphs.en: I am visiting a drugstore in Japan because I need sunscreen and shampoo. The store has many shelves, and I cannot find the products I want. I walk to an employee and say, 'Excuse me, where can I find sunscreen?' The employee points to the skincare section. I thank her and ask, 'Is there a smaller bottle?' I want a travel size because my suitcase is almost full. She shows me two products and explains their prices.
paragraphs.zh: 我在日本藥妝店想買防曬乳和洗髮精。店裡貨架很多，我找不到需要的商品。我向店員問：「不好意思，防曬乳在哪裡？」她指向護膚區。我道謝並問：「有小瓶裝嗎？」因為行李箱快滿了，我想買旅行尺寸。她拿出兩款商品並解釋價格。
paragraphs.ja: 日本のドラッグストアで日焼け止めとシャンプーを探しています。棚が多くて見つからないので、店員に売り場を尋ねます。旅行用の小さいサイズがあるかも確認し、二つの商品と値段を教えてもらいます。

paragraphs.en: One bottle has a discount label, but I do not understand the conditions. I ask, 'Is this the final price?' The employee says the discount applies only when I buy two bottles. I need only one, so I compare the normal prices. I also check the volume because a large bottle is not always the best choice. A low price can be misleading if I buy more than I need. I decide to purchase the smaller bottle and keep my receipt in case I have a question later.
paragraphs.zh: 其中一瓶貼了折扣標籤，但我不懂條件，於是問：「這是最後價格嗎？」店員說買兩瓶才有折扣。我只需要一瓶，所以比較正常價格，也確認容量。便宜不一定划算，尤其買超過需要的量。我決定買小瓶並保留收據。
paragraphs.ja: 一本に割引表示がありますが、二本購入した場合だけ適用されると分かります。一つしか必要ないので通常価格と容量を比べます。安いからといって必要以上に買わず、レシートを保管します。

paragraphs.en: At the checkout counter, I notice a sign about tax-free shopping. I ask, 'Can I buy these items tax-free?' The cashier explains that eligibility depends on the visitor's status, the purchase amount, and other rules. She asks to see the required documents. I understand that I should not assume every tourist or every purchase qualifies. I also know that tax-free goods may have restrictions on use or consumption before leaving Japan. I listen to the cashier's explanation and check the official rules when necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 結帳時我看到免稅標示，問：「這些商品可以免稅嗎？」收銀員說資格取決於旅客身分、購買金額及其他規定，並要求必要文件。我知道不能假設每個旅客、每筆消費都符合資格，也知道免稅品在離境前使用或消耗可能有限制。我仔細聽解釋，必要時核對官方規則。
paragraphs.ja: 会計で免税表示を見つけ、対象になるか尋ねます。資格は滞在資格や購入金額などの条件によります。必要書類を示し、出国前の使用や消費に制限がある場合もあるため、公式の規則を確認します。

paragraphs.en: Before paying, I ask the cashier to repeat the total amount. I check whether the price includes tax and whether the discount has been applied. I pay with my card and take the receipt. If I need to return an item, I will ask about the store's return policy rather than assume that all products can be returned. Today I practiced simple but useful questions about location, size, price, and tax-free eligibility. Clear questions help me shop with confidence and avoid mistakes.
paragraphs.zh: 付款前，我請收銀員複誦總金額，確認是否含稅、折扣是否套用。我刷卡並拿收據。若要退貨，我會詢問店家退貨政策，而不假設所有商品都可退。今天練習了詢問位置、尺寸、價格與免稅資格的簡單實用句型。清楚提問讓購物更安心，也能避免錯誤。
paragraphs.ja: 支払い前に合計金額、税込表示、割引の適用を確認します。カードで支払い、レシートを受け取ります。返品が必要なら店の規則を確認します。場所、サイズ、値段、免税条件を尋ねる表現を練習しました。
